DARKSKY-REPORT v1
TITLE: Community Lighting Proposal
LOCATION: Leo's Glare Gate, the Glarelands mirror of Lantern Lane (fictional)
FIXTURE: Streetlights and a floodlight near homes and a crossing
SOURCE: Simulated game evidence from The Dark Sky (Roblox). Not real measurements.
TOWN: Byers Station is a fictional town.

## PROBLEM
Unshielded lights aimed outward caused glare for walkers and light trespass into homes.

## EVIDENCE
- Crossing light is needed: The crossing sign and the light check both say walkers need this light.
- Shields cut glare: Adding a shield lowered glare while the path stayed lit.
- Simulated game evidence from The Dark Sky (Roblox). Not real measurements.

## BEFORE AND AFTER
- Before: Darkness score 30 / 100 (simulated)
- After: Darkness score 92 / 100 (simulated)

## ALTERNATIVES
- Option A: Shield the lights and aim them at the ground people use | Pros: Useful light where it's needed; safe shadow lanes | Cons: Needs the right shields or fixtures
- Option B: Switch off all the lights | Pros: No glare | Cons: Unsafe for the crossing and sidewalks
- Option C: Keep the lights as they are | Pros: No work needed | Cons: Glare and light trespass continue

## RECOMMENDATION
Shield and aim every light down; dim each to the lowest level that still works.

## TRADE-OFFS
- Safety: Paths, doors, stairs, crossings, and exits keep enough light.
- Ecology: Less light spilling into habitats and the sky; color is one factor among several.
- Energy: Lower brightness and timers mean less wasted energy (game estimate, not a real figure).
- Well-being: Less glare in eyes and less light shining into homes at night.

## ESSENTIAL LIGHTING KEPT
- The crossing light stays on all night.

## NEXT STEPS
- Close curtains at night so indoor light stays inside.
- Share what I learned about responsible lighting with my class.
- Thank neighbors who use shielded, warm, well-aimed lights.
- Share this proposal with a trusted adult or teacher before doing anything.

## REFLECTION
I learned to check evidence before believing a claim, even a friendly one.

## OPTIONAL REAL-WORLD OBSERVATIONS
Optional, completed outside Roblox with a trusted adult. Keep it separate from the simulated evidence above. Never climb, touch, unscrew, or rewire light fixtures.

END OF REPORT
